summary: 9 events detected across 12 domains. 4 Category-5 (severity 5) events: US Treasury bond intervention, Japan yen/JGB crisis, Strait of Hormuz war disruption, Ebola PHEIC. Board remains CRITICAL.

events.title: US Treasury Emergency Bond Buyback - Bessent Intervenes to Cap Yields
events.description: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced emergency measures to artificially cap runaway US government debt yields. Treasury doubling long-dated bond buybacks from $2B to $4B per operation. Bond market alarms forced emergency Treasury buyback plan. Interventionist tactics to push down borrowing costs.

events.title: Coordinated US-Japan Yen Intervention Failed - JGB Yields at 30-Year Highs
events.description: Rare coordinated US-Japan currency intervention failed to sustain yen gains. Yen weakened back to 159 after temporary strengthening to 155. 10-year JGB yield at 2.95% - highest since 1996. BOJ expected to hike rates in September (80% probability). Japan leading global bond selloff. Bond vigilantes spooked by proposed consumption tax cuts.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis - Iran Retaliatory Strikes on Oil Infrastructure
events.description: Active 2026 Iran war. Iran launched retaliatory missile/drone strikes targeting US embassies, military installations, and oil infrastructure including vessels in Strait of Hormuz. Iran threatens to block all oil exports through Hormuz. Saudi Arabia forced to reroute oil away from Bab al-Mandab Strait due to Houthi attacks. Brent crude spiked 10-13%. EIA estimates 0.6M bpd disruptions through end of 2027.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - Fastest Growing Outbreak on Record, WHO PHEIC Declared
events.description: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). 5,290 confirmed cases, 2,516 deaths across 56 health zones. Africa CDC estimates only 30-40% of infections detected - actual cases could be 3x higher. Existing treatments certified for Zaire ebolavirus, not Bundibugyo - complicating response.

events.title: Fifth US Bank Failure of 2026 - Small Bank Closure Trend Accelerating
events.description: Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank (Philadelphia, $68M assets) became 5th US bank failure of 2026, matching all of 2023. FDIC-listed. Small banks being left behind. Trend accelerating.

events.title: Gold Surges Past $4,620 - Safe Haven Panic on US Debt Fears
events.description: Spot gold above $4,620/oz, up 15% in August alone. Three-month high driven by US debt fears, Treasury bond buybacks weakening dollar, Iran war uncertainty.

events.title: Israel-Gaza Ceasefire Collapsing - Escalation Despite US-Brokered Truce
events.description: Israeli strikes escalating in Gaza despite US-brokered ceasefire. Senior officers describing return to pre-ceasefire rules of engagement. Kushner talks failed to resolve core issues.

events.title: Colombia Deports Venezuelan Migrants - Border Tensions Escalating
events.description: Colombia President de la Espriella orders immediate deportation of irregular migrants, mainly Venezuelans. Complete reversal of decade-long policy. US intervention in Venezuela ongoing.

events.title: Global Food Crisis Deepening - Hormuz Disruption + UK Farming Crisis
events.description: FAO warns fertilizer scarcity from Hormuz disruption will lower yields through 2027. UK farmers warn of food shortages within months. Somalia hunger crisis worsening. 8 million Chinese listed as loan defaulters from mortgage defaults.
